Official implementation of the paper: Sub-JEPA: Subspace Gaussian Regularization for Stable End-to-End World Models.

# Sub-JEPA: Subspace Gaussian Regularization for Stable End-to-End World Models Official implementation of the paper: **Sub-JEPA: Subspace Gaussian Regularization for Stable End-to-End World Models**. [ ](https://kaizhao.net/sub-jepa) [ ](https://github.com/intcomp/Sub-JEPA) [ ](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09241) [ ](https://huggingface.co/intcomp/sub-jepa) --- ## Overview Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) offer an effective framework for learning world models, but without sufficient constraints, their representation spaces can easily collapse. While recent methods like LeWM prevent this by enforcing a strong isotropic Gaussian prior in the high-dimensional ambient space, this can introduce an overly strong structural bias. **Sub-JEPA** relaxes this global constraint by applying Gaussian regularization across multiple random subspaces instead of the original embedding space. ## Main Result Sub-JEPA consistently improves over LeWM across four continuous-control environments. | Method | Two-Room | Reacher | PushT | OGB-Cube | | -------- | ---------------: | ---------------: | ---------------: | ---------------: | | LeWM | 84.33 ± 4.23 | 82.67 ± 4.42 | 84.67 ± 6.53 | 67.33 ± 5.01 | | Sub-JEPA | **95.00 ± 2.76** | **84.00 ± 4.00** | **89.00 ± 5.33** | **76.33 ± 5.99** | --- ## Repository Layout ## Installation ### 1. Clone the repository If you forgot `--recursive`, you can run: ### 2. Set up the environment + data (same as LeWM) Follow the upstream LeWM instructions: - Installation: https://github.com/lucas-maes/le-wm#using-the-code - Data layout: https://github.com/lucas-maes/le-wm#data In particular, LeWM (and this repo) expects datasets and checkpoints under `$STABLEWM_HOME` (defaults to `~/.stable-wm/`). ## Pretrained Checkpoints We provide pretrained Sub-JEPA checkpoints on [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/intcomp/sub-jepa). abstract_zh: 这是论文《Sub-JEPA：用于稳定端到端世界模型的子空间高斯正则化》的官方实现。联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）为学习世界模型提供了有效框架，但若缺乏足够的约束，其表示空间容易崩溃。尽管近期方法如LeWM通过在高维环境空间中施加强各向同性高斯先验来防止崩溃，但这可能引入过强的结构偏差。Sub-JEPA通过将高斯正则化应用于多个随机子空间而非原始嵌入空间，放松了这一全局约束。主要结果表明，Sub-JEPA在四个连续控制环境中持续优于LeWM。
tldr_zh: Sub-JEPA通过子空间高斯正则化稳定世界模型训练，在多个控制任务上超越LeWM。
cover_zh: 还在为世界模型崩溃头疼？子空间正则化让训练稳如老狗，性能全面反超！

judge.reason: 官方实现Sub-JEPA世界模型，改进JEPA稳定性，有实验验证。
